components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. It
            must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored and returned value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. A
            present-but-invalid value is rejected with a 400.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows an owner that shares a household with an
            existing owner — same last name and same address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) — to be created instead
            of being rejected with a 409.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of
                owners at the time of creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the household. Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' true — the joining owner and the existing
                owner(s) that share the household (same last name and same address,
                compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) all carry the same
                value. Null for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-3a2b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                that share the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0) and an email address is present,
                otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registrationDate at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the GOLD membership tier rule: `membershipTier` is `'GOLD'` when the owner's household (owners sharing the same `householdId`) has 3+ members after the create; otherwise the existing SILVER/BRONZE rules apply.

Following the established pattern used for `namesakeCount` (a create-time snapshot persisted on the entity and read by the mapper), I:

1. **New pipeline step** — `AssignOwnerHouseholdSize.java`: counts owners sharing the new owner's `householdId` after this create (the persisted, backfilled members plus the not-yet-saved new owner; owners with no household get size 1) and stores it on the entity.

2. **Wired it into `owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `household-size` step right after `household-id` (`AssignHousehold`), so the shared `householdId` is already assigned and existing members backfilled before counting, and before `save`. It carries `govern: [ transaction ]` like its neighbors.

3. **`Owner` entity** — added the `householdSize` field mapped to a new `household_size` column, with getter/setter.

4. **Schemas** — added `household_size INTEGER` to the owners table in all four dialects (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres). Tests run on hsqldb.

5. **`OwnerMapper`** — updated the `membershipTier` expression to return `GOLD` when `householdSize >= 3`, otherwise falling through to the existing SILVER/BRONZE logic.

6. **`openapi.yml`** — updated the `membershipTier` description to document the GOLD rule.

Because the size is a snapshot captured at create time (not recomputed at read), it correctly reflects "3 or more members **after this create**" per the specification.
